system.description: Automatically assume an inert, clinically and spiritually dead cadaver state at any time, immune to sunlight and True Faith, with no aura, no Disciplines, and no nightly hunger or torpor. Awakening costs two Blood Traits. Excess Blood Pool above 10 erupts violently if your body is cut open, and lethal damage that would normally kill a resilient vampire still inflicts Final Death, as does decapitation or total incineration.
